review_notes.notes.1: The currently linked AY26-27 handbook describes bachelor-degree entry, with no required CS major, and expects mathematical/programming aptitude. It is not a complete list of exception-free admission coursework; Fall 2027 policy changes remain possible.

source_excerpt: An undergraduate degree in Computer Science is not required.
fact_summary: The current linked handbook supports bachelor-level entry without a CS-only major requirement. Programming and mathematics describe preparation, not an invented mandatory course checklist.
